## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

List the commands or workflows used to verify the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves existing behavior unless noted above.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and examples are documented.
- [ ] `python -m pytest` passes.
- [ ] `python -m ruff check .` passes.
- [ ] The Sphinx documentation builds with warnings treated as errors.
- [ ] No confidential data, credentials, generated build output, or unlicensed
      third-party material is included.
